title: MCite-RL: Towards Reliable Multimodal RAG via Citation-enhanced Agentic Reinforcement Learning

visual_explainer.question: What does bbox-aware reward supervise in an iterative visual retrieval-and-crop agent?
visual_explainer.takeaway: Answer reward and final localization rewards jointly shape a retrieve/crop/answer trajectory, but the cited process reward is measured on the terminal crop rather than every intermediate step.
visual_explainer.compared_with: The same SFT+RL package with citation reward terms removed.

analysis.tldr: MCite-RL adds bounding-box localization rewards to an iterative visual RAG package. Internal ablations improve citation IoU and answer score, but the 'process' term is evaluated only on the terminal crop, teacher filtering retains just 8.6% of generated trajectories, and semantic evidence validity plus runtime cost remain weakly measured.
analysis.problem: A multimodal RAG agent may answer correctly without identifying which image region supports the answer, leaving evidence use hard to verify.
analysis.core_idea: Train retrieve/crop/answer trajectories with answer reward plus final-box IoU and terminal-crop IoGT reward, then emit an answer with a citation box.
analysis.agent_loop: retrieve image → crop region → inspect → repeat if needed → answer with bounding-box citation
analysis.retrieval_design: The visual agent searches and crops, while citation reward is attached to final localization. The closest attribution is a within-package reward ablation, not the external end-to-end leaderboard.
compared_to: VRAG-RL under the authors' training data
analysis.evidence: On Wiki-VISA 7B, full reaches answer/citation 60.00/36.05 versus 54.20/20.56 without all citation rewards. Removing answer reward raises citation to 41.65 while answer falls to 53.20, exposing objective tension.
analysis.why_it_matters: It makes visual evidence localization a learnable output rather than leaving citations implicit in an answer trajectory.
limitations: The process-level term uses only terminal crop c_T, not intermediate-step supervision.
The synthesis prompt receives gold answer and gold coordinates, and only 2,417 of 28,175 trajectories survive filtering.
BBox overlap does not by itself establish semantic support; the LLM support judge lacks human-agreement reporting.
No teacher-call cost or test-time tokens, crop calls, latency, dollars, and stop distribution is reported.
The 3B model has OOD answer reversals, and removing process reward can improve one citation cell.
